deadline.value: Apply by November 15, 2026 for fall 2027 (fall entry only listed).
deadline.quote: Neuroscience PhD Tempe Fall A/C Nov. 15

gre_general.value: GRE is not required for SOLS graduate programs; you may send scores if you have them.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for all SOLS graduate programs. However, if you have taken the test and would like to send your scores

gre_subject.value: No GRE (general or subject) is required by SOLS.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required for all SOLS graduate programs.

fee_waiver.value: SOLS cannot waive the fee, but a prospective faculty advisor may pay it for you.
fee_waiver.quote: The SOLS Graduate Office does not have the ability to waive the application fee, but instead, a faculty member may pay for the application fee on your behalf.

supervisor.value: Not required, but contacting potential advisors first is highly recommended to find who is recruiting.
supervisor.quote: For thesis-based programs: although it is not required, it is highly recommended to contact potential faculty advisors in advance to find out who is actively recruiting to take on new students.

funding.value: PhD students are guaranteed five years of funding (assistantship stipend, tuition and health insurance); program fees are extra.
funding.quote: PhD students are guaranteed five years of funding (i.e., stipends for assistantships, tuition coverage, health insurance coverage).

entry_route.value: Apply directly to the PhD with a bachelor's or a master's.
entry_route.quote: You can apply directly into the PhD program with a bachelor’s or a master’s degree, and all accepted applicants enter as PhD pre-candidates.

notes: Listed among SOLS doctoral programs; same SOLS-wide FAQ rules apply.
